lines.t: You remember the Sabbath, and I remember you
You bless this holy day, and I pour blessings through
You lay down your labor, leave the world outside
You rest in my presence, in my peace you abide
For I am the Lord, maker of earth and sky
I fashioned all creation, then I rested high
Shabbat shalom
I am calling you to rest, six days you have labored, now the seventh day is blessed
Shabbat shalom
Let your worries fall away, you remember the Sabbath and I remember you today
You put away your works, let the clamor cease You turn your heart toward me, in wonder and in peace
Your thoughts dwell upon your God, and saving King
In all of all my works, you lift your voice and sing
For I am the Lord who made the stars above
I draw you to my table with everlasting love
Shabbat shalom
I am calling you to rest six days
You have labor, now the seventh day is better
Shabbat shalom
Let your worries fall away
You remember the Sabbath and I remember you today
You'll bear your cross for six long days
But on the seven, let me raise
The weight you carry, the heavy load
I lifted from you on this holy road
So you rejoice, and you are glad
For this is my will, let your heart be made glad
You lay your cares down
I lift you up, you come to my Sabbath I overflow your cup, you choose my rest
I surround you with my light You honor this day and I hold you through the night
Shabbat shalom I am calling you to rest
Six days you have labored, now the seventh day is blessed
Shabbat shalom Let your fears be swept away
You remember the Sabbath and I remember you
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Shabbat Shalom
Let your praises rise above
For this is my will for you
Rejoice in my love
